info.title: Nexo API
info.description: Fiscal centralizing API for integration between sales systems, government and accounting platforms.

post.summary: Create an agent token for an organization
post.description: Generates a one-time-visible Bearer token that the nexo-agent daemon uses to authenticate. Store it immediately — it cannot be recovered.

organization_id.description: ID of the organization the agent will represent.

name.description: Optional label to identify this token (max 100 chars).

201.description: Token created. Copy the token value — it will not be shown again.

token.description: Plain-text token. Pass as Bearer in Authorization header. Only shown once.

agent_token_id.description: Internal ID of the created token record.

422.description: Validation error — organization_id missing or not found.

get.description: Called by the daemon at startup to get the WebSocket server details. This way the agent only needs the nexo_url and its token — no infrastructure details need to be distributed manually.

post.summary: Heartbeat — marks the agent as online
post.description: The daemon calls this every 15 seconds. The server uses the last_seen_at timestamp to decide whether to push tasks via WebSocket or queue them as pending_fiscal.

get.description: Called by the agent immediately after reconnecting to Reverb. Returns all sales with status=pending_fiscal for this organization, with their TaxCore-formatted payloads ready to send to V-SDC.

payload.description: TaxCore-formatted invoice payload ready to send to V-SDC.

post.description: After the agent calls V-SDC and gets a response (or an error), it POSTs the result here. The server marks the sale as completed or failed accordingly. Idempotent: if the sale is already completed, the request is ignored.

sale_id.description: ID of the sale being fiscalized.

task_id.description: Task UUID from the original fiscalization.requested event.

ok.description: true if V-SDC returned a successful response, false on error.

fiscal_number.description: invoiceNumber from V-SDC response. Required when ok=true.

fiscal_result.description: Full JSON body returned by V-SDC. Stored as-is for audit.

403.description: The sale does not belong to the agent's organization.

post.description: Called by the nexo-agent daemon after connecting to the Reverb WebSocket. Validates the agent token and returns a Pusher HMAC signature so the daemon can subscribe to private-agent.{org_id}.

socket_id.description: Socket ID provided by Reverb in the pusher:connection_established event.

channel_name.description: Must be private-agent.{organization_id} matching the token's org.

200.description: Auth signature generated. Use the auth value in pusher:subscribe.

403.description: channel_name does not match this token's organization.

post.description: Authenticates an admin user with email and password, returns a JWT with the user scopes.
Exchanges the current (expired) token for a new one. The new token carries the same scopes as the old one.

get.description: Returns the authenticated admin user with their scopes.

post.description: Invalidates the current JWT so it can no longer be used.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of buyers belonging to the given organization. Admin endpoint, no authentication required.

parameters.name: organization_id
parameters.description: ID of the organization to filter buyers by.

parameters.name: perPage
parameters.description: Number of results per page. Defaults to 15.

422.description: Validation error — organization_id missing or invalid.

post.description: Creates a buyer in the catalog. The document_number must be unique within the organization. Admin endpoint, no authentication required.

409.description: Conflict — buyer with same document number already exists in this organization.

get.description: Returns a single buyer. Admin endpoint, no authentication required.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: ID of the buyer.

put.description: Updates name and/or document_number. The document_number must remain unique within the organization. Admin endpoint, no authentication required.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: ID of the buyer to update.

document_number.description: New document number, or null to clear.

409.description: Conflict — buyer with same document number already exists in this organization.

delete.description: Permanently removes a buyer from the catalog. Admin endpoint, no authentication required.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: ID of the buyer to delete.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of connectors belonging to the given organization.

parameters.name: organization_id
parameters.description: ID of the organization to filter connectors by.

parameters.name: perPage
parameters.description: Number of results per page. Defaults to 10.

post.description: Creates a connector for the given organization. The token is only returned in this response and cannot be retrieved later.

organization_id.description: ID of the organization this connector belongs to.

allowed_events.description: List of event types this connector is allowed to send. Null means all events are allowed.

active.description: Whether the connector is active. Defaults to true.

token.description: Bearer token — only visible at creation.

409.description: Conflict — connector name already exists in this organization

message.example: A connector with the same name already exists in this organization.

get.description: Returns a single connector. The token is never exposed in this response.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: ID of the connector.

put.description: Updates the name, allowed events, and active status. The token and organization cannot be changed.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: ID of the connector to update.

name.description: New name. Must be unique within the organization.

allowed_events.description: Updated list of allowed event types. Send null to allow all events.

409.description: Conflict — connector name already exists in this organization

message.example: A connector with the same name already exists in this organization.

delete.description: Permanently deletes a connector. Existing integration events referencing this connector will also be removed (cascade).

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: ID of the connector to delete.

post.description: Ingests an event sent by an external connector (e.g. a POS system). Requires the connector's Bearer token for authentication.

external_event_id.description: Optional UUID from the originating system, used for idempotency. Must be unique across all events.

event_type.description: Type of the event being sent (e.g. invoice.created).

payload.description: Arbitrary JSON object containing the event data.

401.description: Unauthenticated — missing or invalid connector token

403.description: Forbidden — connector is inactive or event type is not allowed

message.example: This connector is not allowed to send events of type invoice.created.

422.description: Validation error — required fields missing or invalid

items.example: The event type field is required.

post.summary: Register a TaxCore connection in agent mode
post.description: Creates a TaxCore connection record without storing the certificate or PAC on the server. The nexo-agent daemon holds them securely in the OS keychain (DPAPI on Windows) and calls V-SDC directly via mTLS.

get.description: Stores the organization_id in the server session and redirects to the Xero authorization page to begin the OAuth2 flow. After the user grants access, Xero redirects to the callback URL where the connection is saved and linked to this organization.

parameters.name: organization_id
parameters.description: ID of the organization to link the Xero connection to.

422.description: Validation error — organization_id missing or not found.

get.description: Handles the redirect from Xero after the user authorizes the app. Exchanges the authorization code for tokens, links the connection to the organization stored in session (set during /connect), and persists the XeroConnection record. This endpoint is called automatically by Xero — do not call it directly.

parameters.name: code
parameters.description: Authorization code returned by Xero.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: CSRF state token returned by Xero to verify the request origin.

200.description: Xero connection established and linked to organization successfully.

scopes.example: openid email profile offline_access accounting.settings accounting.transactions accounting.contacts

422.description: Invalid OAuth callback — missing or malformed state parameter, or invalid authorization code.

message.example: Invalid OAuth callback: missing state parameter.

get.summary: List Xero contacts for a connection
get.description: Fetches the list of contacts from Xero using the given connection. The connection must belong to an organization. Tokens are refreshed automatically if expired.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: ID of the Xero connection (returned by the callback endpoint).

post.description: Creates or updates one or more Items (Products & Services) in the Xero account linked to the connector's organization. Xero performs an upsert by `code` — if the item already exists it is updated, otherwise it is created. The calling system has full control over pricing and account codes. Requires the connector's Bearer token.

code.description: Unique item code used as the upsert key in Xero.

salesAccountCode.description: Xero account code for sales (e.g. Revenue account).

purchaseAccountCode.description: Xero account code for purchases (e.g. COGS account).

200.description: Items synced successfully. Returns the raw Xero API response.

401.description: Unauthorized — missing or invalid connector token.

404.description: No active Xero connection found for this organization.

422.description: Validation error — missing or invalid fields.

post.description: Receives Xero webhook events. The request must carry an `x-xero-signature` header computed as `base64(HMAC-SHA256(raw_body, XERO_WEBHOOK_KEY))`. Returns 200 within 5s and processes events asynchronously via ProcessXeroWebhookEventJob.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of organizations. Optionally filter by name using the search parameter.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Filter organizations by name (case-insensitive partial match).

parameters.name: perPage
parameters.description: Number of results per page. Defaults to 10.

post.description: Creates an organization after validating the request at both HTTP and domain levels. The name must be unique (case-insensitive).

name.description: Organization display name. Must be unique.

tax_id.description: Tax identification number. Digits and hyphens only.

items.example: The organization name must be at least 3 characters long.
The organization's tax ID must be at least 11 characters long.

message.example: An organization with the same name already exists.

get.description: Returns a single organization by its ID.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: ID of the organization.

put.description: Updates an existing organization. The name must remain unique (case-insensitive) across all organizations.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: ID of the organization to update.

name.description: Organization display name. Must be unique.

tax_id.description: Tax identification number. Digits and hyphens only.

message.example: An organization with the same name already exists.

items.example: The organization name must be at least 3 characters long.
The organization's tax ID must be at least 11 characters long.

delete.description: Deletes an organization by ID. The operation is rejected if the organization has associated records (e.g. connectors) to avoid orphaned references.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: ID of the organization to delete.

409.description: Cannot delete — organization has associated records

message.example: Cannot delete Organization: it has associated records in [connectors].

get.description: Returns the paginated payments applied to the given sale. Admin endpoint, no authentication required.

parameters.name: saleId
parameters.description: ID of the sale.

parameters.name: perPage
parameters.description: Number of results per page. Defaults to 15.

post.summary: Create a payment for a sale
post.description: Persists a new payment snapshot linked to the given sale. Admin endpoint, no authentication required.

parameters.name: saleId
parameters.description: ID of the sale.

get.description: Returns a single payment snapshot. Admin endpoint, no authentication required.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: ID of the payment.

put.description: Updates amount and/or payment_type. Admin endpoint, no authentication required.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: ID of the payment to update.

delete.description: Permanently removes a payment snapshot. Admin endpoint, no authentication required.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: ID of the payment to delete.

post.description: Accepts a sale payload and dispatches it for asynchronous processing. Step 1: creates a Xero Invoice (ACCREC). Step 2 (only if Xero succeeds): sends the invoice to TaxCore for fiscal signing. Returns immediately with a sale ID and pending status. Poll GET /api/sales/{id} for the result.

dueDate.description: Invoice due date sent to Xero (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to today if omitted.

referentDocumentNumber.description: Required for Refund (transactionType=1) or Copy/Advance (invoiceType=2 or 4).

name.description: Buyer name used as Contact in Xero Invoice.

id.description: Buyer tax ID sent to TaxCore as buyerId.

code.description: Xero ItemCode — must match an existing Xero item.

accountCode.description: Xero account code for the line item.

401.description: Unauthorized — missing or invalid connector token.

422.description: Validation error — missing or invalid fields.

get.description: Returns the current status and result of a previously submitted sale. Poll this endpoint until status is completed or failed. On completed, fiscal_number and xero_invoice_id are populated.

401.description: Unauthorized — missing or invalid connector token.

get.summary: List fiscalized invoices (read from local DB)
get.description: Returns invoices persisted in the `sales` table after being signed by TaxCore. By default returns only `status=completed`. Supports filtering by invoice/transaction type, fiscal number and date range. organization_id is required. No authentication required.

parameters.name: organization_id
parameters.description: ID of the organization whose invoices to list.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Filter by status. Defaults to completed.

parameters.name: invoiceType
parameters.description: 0=Normal, 1=ProForma, 2=Copy, 3=Training, 4=Advance.

parameters.name: transactionType
parameters.description: 0=Sale, 1=Refund.

parameters.name: fiscalNumber
parameters.description: Exact fiscal invoice number (TaxCore invoiceNumber).

parameters.name: dateFrom
parameters.description: Start date (YYYY-MM-DD). Filters by created_at.

parameters.name: dateTo
parameters.description: End date (YYYY-MM-DD). Must be on or after dateFrom.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Items per page (max 100).

get.summary: Get a single fiscalized invoice (read from local DB)
get.description: Returns the full Sale record by its internal ID, including the original request payload, the TaxCore signed response and the Xero response. Reads from the `sales` table. organization_id is required and the sale is verified to belong to that organization. No authentication required.

parameters.name: organization_id
parameters.description: ID of the organization that owns the invoice.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Internal Sale ID.

404.description: Invoice not found for this organization.

agentToken.description: Bearer token issued by POST /api/agent/token. Used by the nexo-agent daemon to authenticate all agent endpoints.

bearerAuth.description: Bearer JWT issued by POST /api/auth/login. Pass as: Authorization: Bearer <token>

connectorToken.description: Bearer token issued when a Connector is created. Only visible at creation time.

tags.name: Agent
tags.description: Endpoints for the nexo-agent desktop daemon. The daemon connects via WebSocket (Reverb) and receives fiscalization tasks pushed by the server.

tags.name: Authentication
tags.description: Admin authentication endpoints. Login returns a JWT containing scopes that authorize access to admin endpoints.

tags.name: Buyers
tags.description: Catalog of buyers (customers) belonging to each organization. Buyer entries are mutable; immutable buyer snapshots inside sales continue to live in the Sale payload.

tags.name: Connectors
tags.description: Endpoints for managing connectors. A connector represents an external system integration point linked to an organization.

tags.name: Integration Events
tags.description: Endpoints for receiving integration events from external connectors.

tags.name: TaxCore Integration
tags.description: Endpoints for managing the TaxCore fiscal integration. The nexo-agent daemon holds the certificate and PAC on the client machine and calls V-SDC directly.

tags.name: Xero Integration
tags.description: Endpoints for connecting and interacting with the Xero accounting platform via OAuth2.

tags.name: Xero Products
tags.description: Endpoints for syncing products (Items) to the Xero accounting platform. Requires an active Xero connection for the organization and a valid connector Bearer token.

tags.name: Xero Webhooks
tags.description: Webhook receiver — authenticated by HMAC signature, not Bearer token.

tags.name: Payments
tags.description: Per-sale payment snapshots. Each payment belongs to a Sale. payment_type is the TaxCore/V-SDC code (0-6).

tags.name: Sales
tags.description: Endpoints for submitting sales. Each sale is registered asynchronously in both Xero (Invoice ACCREC) and TaxCore (fiscal signing). Requires the connector's Bearer token.
